# Ken Johnson Portfolio

> Ken Johnson, also known as Kenneth Johnson, is a senior product manager and product builder working with startups and founders on product strategy and solving problems with software or AI.

This portfolio contains a biography, contact information, and first-person case studies. Historical financial figures in the case studies are approximate work-record accounts, not independently audited results. Product links and dated activity snapshots have separate meanings described on each page.

## About and Work

- [About Ken Johnson](https://kennethjohnsontech.github.io/): Biography, product management roles and advisory work, social profiles, and contact details.
- [Selected Work](https://kennethjohnsontech.github.io/work.html): Overview of Slack Reimagined, an interview concept, and Ken's work on MailLead, LazyLeadz, and LeadQuest.

## Case Studies

- [Slack Reimagined](https://kennethjohnsontech.github.io/work/slack-reimagined.html): An AI-native Slack product-strategy concept for a Late Checkout Agency interview, with a video walkthrough and interactive deck. Proposed experiences and illustrative savings, not shipped features or measured results.
- [MailLead](https://kennethjohnsontech.github.io/work/maillead.html): Acquisition evaluation, build-versus-buy judgment, stakeholder alignment, and product and go-to-market work.
- [LazyLeadz](https://kennethjohnsontech.github.io/work/lazyleadz.html): Engineering hiring, data sourcing, product design, and delivery of a searchable and exportable lead database.
- [LeadQuest](https://kennethjohnsontech.github.io/work/leadquest.html): Product diagnosis, design, and implementation with AI coding agents, including a historical search-quality rollback lesson.

## Optional

- [Writing and Contact](https://kennethjohnsontech.github.io/writing.html): Contact Ken and find case-study notes. No standalone articles are published on this page yet.
